messages:
maria: Quick heads up — ran into a tenant where a wildcard scope + route alias ended up exposing internal RPC endpoints in the console. not catastrophic but confusing for admins.
jon: ah — is this the /internal/call-* routes that are meant for our infra services? :thinking_face:
sara: can you paste the exact binding? curious whether it's a console UX leak or an API auth bug.
maria: here's the binding (sanitized):
```json
{
  "role": "tenant-admin",
  "scopes": ["routes:*"]
}
```
and route list shows `internal.call-health` alongside customer-facing routes.
kevin: sounds like our scope semantics treat `routes:*` as "all registered routes" regardless of meta tag (internal/public). we should have a filter based on route.allowList or tag.`
alice: agreed. two parts to fix: platform API should return a visibility flag per-route (computed from tags + sensitivity), and console should hide internal routes by default unless a user has explicit entitlements.
jon: for the API change — would it be a thin boolean field `visible_to_tenant_admin`? or something more flexible like `visibility_scope: [public,internal,system]`?
kevin: prefer enum `visibility_level` so future tooling can operate on it. boolean gets awkward when we add partner/internal split.
sara: UX-wise we can show an "internal routes" toggle in advanced view with a small warning tooltip. default collapsed. also add an affordance to request access (opens a support flow).
maria: telemetry ask: can we surface an alert for roles that match wide scopes but have recently accessed internal routes? e.g., detect suspicious scope expansion.
alice: yes — we can emit a signal when a route with visibility_level != public is served to a token whose scopes are wildcard-like. tag as `rbac:overlap` in telemetry.
ops-bot: incident-notify: new alert policy suggestion created: `RBAC_WIDE_SCOPE_INTERNAL_ACCESS` by alice at 2023-09-18T15:12:03Z
jon: API change checklist: 1) add visibility_level to route manifest 2) backfill existing routes via tags 3) console hide by default + advanced toggle 4) add telemetry rule and dashboard widget
kevin: also need a migration plan for Dedicated/Private customers where they may rely on internal routes being visible. feature flag rollout + sampling is safe.
sara: mockups incoming — will put a compact chip per-route that shows visibility_level and a hover explanation.
maria: OK — next steps: jon + kevin to draft API schema and migration notes, sara to drop a quick mock in #design, alice to draft telemetry event and alert definition.
alice: I'll also add a short blurb for the rollout announcement: explain why some routes will disappear from tenant view unless explicitly enabled.
jon: timeline? can we aim for a canary rollout next week with feature flag off by default?
kevin: yes — we'll gate by entitlement flag and enable only for 10% of clusters first.
maria: thanks all. low-pri follow-ups: consider audit export that lists which roles would be impacted before rollout. would be helpful for enterprise customers.
sara: noted. I'll add it to the mock notes. :+1:
